info.title: Browser Phone API
info.description: Base path is /api/public/v1 on the host serving Browser Phone. Webhook and phone capabilities use Authorization: Bearer headers, never query strings. Optional same-origin account routes use an HttpOnly session cookie and are unavailable until MojoAuth is configured. Live webhook registration/delivery requires independently enforced public-only egress attestation or startup-installed Node checked-address pinning; other deployments fail closed. GET /connections reports capability. Requests are streamed with a 16KB cap, webhook responses 64KB.

connectionToken.description: bp_conn_… — returned once by POST /connections. Scope: verify, sessions, usage, revoke for one connection. Expires after BP_CONNECTION_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS (default 7 days).

phoneToken.description: bp_phone_… — per session. Scope: post events and read the inbox of that session only.

callbackToken.description: bp_cb_… — delivered only to the verified webhook inside each event. Scope: post messages into that session only.

accountCookie.name: __Host-bp_session
accountCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly host-only SameSite=Lax Secure cookie; bp_session on HTTP localhost. Seven-day expiry. Account routes have no cross-origin CORS access. Not an OIDC token.

shareToken.description: bp_share_ capability returned once to the verified owner. Only reads this shared phone and creates isolated tester sessions under its lifetime call allowance. Cannot manage owner connections or other inboxes. Hash-only server storage. Expires/revokes with link or connection. URL fragment only for initial link; API token goes in Authorization header.

voice.description: Only documented api.elevenlabs.io conversation WebSocket path is accepted, with agent_id and either conversation_signature or legacy token query parameters and no credentials/fragments/ports. Opaque WebRTC tokens and unverified regional hosts fail closed. Public agent SDK flows are supported; provider-side limits required.

post.description: Webhook receives {id,type,created_at,session_id,session_kind,reply_url,callback_token,data} with header X-BrowserPhone-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(signing_secret, t.body)>. The webhook may respond with {reply:{text,link}} or, for call.start, {voice:{…}}. Atomic delivery states are pending/succeeded/retryable. Same-ID failed requests redeliver; concurrent duplicates return 409 delivery_pending; a 30-second lease permits recovery on retry. Successful response including voice is cached. Receiver deduplication remains mandatory.

post.description: Verified, current owner capability required. Maximum20 active links/connection. Expiry capped by connection expiry. Token returned only once; listing metadata never contains it. No permanent owner/provider secrets exposed. Call allowance is additional to daily webhook/concurrency/duration quotas. UI presets1,3,5/custom.

post.summary: Reserve an isolated tester chat or call session
post.description: Atomic lifetime call allowance shared by every tester, plus existing fingerprint daily/concurrency quotas through bp_create_session. A new call session counts one attempt, even if subsequent mic/provider setup fails. Opening the page and idempotent retries do not count. Chat does not decrement call allowance. Exhausted call returns429 share_exhausted. Session/credential bounds never exceed link/connection expiry. Kind-changing or ended/expired idempotent replay is rejected. Revoke/expiry denies events/inbox/callbacks. Shared call.start is normalized to one canonical leased event/session. Does not forcibly revoke previously issued provider credentials or guarantee a provider billing cap.
